geotiff.notes: Follow-up #1220: GPU predictor=2 kernel over-indexed d_decomp for multi-sample tiled TIFFs (silent OOB GPU write). Fixed by passing width=tile_width instead of tile_width*samples.

rasterize.notes: HIGH: unbounded out/written allocation in _run_numpy/_run_cupy driven by user-supplied width/height/resolution (no cap). MEDIUM (unfixed): _build_row_csr_numba total=row_ptr[height] is int32 and can wrap for very tall rasters with many long edges.
